answer: A web of trust stops Sybil floods the way a cedar grove shelters a coastline: a new identity can only earn once established agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes its own reputation on the newcomer. If the vouched agent turns out fake, the voucher loses standing too, so vouching is rationed carefully. An attacker facing an ocean of honest agents on the horizon would need to buy or fool many trusted sponsors first, a cost that grows with every fake, while honest newcomers arrive through real relationships.
